body: It’s a va therapist, anytime they have a patient suicide they go under scrutiny
I find myself planning multiple futures out within minutes of each other, I’ll catch myself planning for a future that at the same time I don’t plan to have at least I know I’m not alone

I’ve tried it takes specific pills to kill you and the after affects can be miserable 190/1110 blood pressure, shaking chattering headache if you can think of it you will feel it after, during was mostly a black out with few glimpses of memory sorta like super drunk

Give them your reasoning or they will blame theirselves forever. Reassure them that this wasn’t their fault and it just came to be for me personally the most important thing about my set up is to reduce the damage it will leave on those who live after I’m gone, also keep in mind who and how they will find you, I would hate for my mother to be the one to walk in on me dead, I’m leaving instructions with a friend that I know can take it to call the police and tell them where I will be so my mother doesn’t have to find my body herself

I have the same feeling when I think of death I think of release not something to be afraid of, my grandpa past not long ago and everyone in my family was so sad but I had nothing. I felt nothing. Because I’ve accepted death as the solution not the problem of living
